summary: Marti Technologies filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its board increased its share repurchase authorization from $2.5 million to $5.0 million and extended the program through April 26, 2027, while maintaining the $6.00 per-share ceiling. Roughly $3.8 million remained available as of September 9, 2026, when shares closed at $2.13. Since January 2024, Marti has repurchased 795,467 Class A shares at a $1.95 average, about $1.6 million aggregate. Repurchases may occur via open-market or privately negotiated transactions under Rule 10b-18. Watch execution pace relative to the modest authorization, thin liquidity, and the wide gap between the ceiling and market price.
